future_check: Re-run strict authority sync and sampled execution parity whenever canonical, target_code, raw_code, or the generator rule pin changes.
rationale: Replacing both task-local fields would erase provenance even though the old raw source is execution-equivalent. The repair makes target_code the selected canonical source, labels raw_code archival, pins RULE_HASH 79b7067ac64d, and preserves measured execution parity across both texts.
summary: The selected task rule is now byte-exact with canonical while the previously executable alternate spelling remains explicitly archival.

future_check: Monitor anchor support with count-backed 200-per-band censuses; reconsider the schedule only if a disjoint large census falls below the contractual 5% per-band floor or loses a band entirely.
rationale: The configured anchor probability is 30%, and the two independent 600-draw censuses observed 183/600 and 183/600 anchors. The 60-draw result is compatible with sampling variance and does not indicate missing canonical support, but intake should preserve the warning rather than relabel it as a hard pass.
summary: The fixed 60-draw canonical-profile gate observed 14 anchors (23.3%), below its 25% advisory line, despite nonzero support in all bands.

future_check: Keep at least one D4-unique source in each materialized lesson and verify both target slots against the authoritative Racket output.
rationale: Two canonical panels have reflection symmetry and all use repeated colors, which can obscure the operation. Cellwise comparison of all four official outputs and D4-unique generated panels falsifies copy, counterclockwise, reflection, and color-count-only alternatives.
summary: Generic copying or reflection is not an adequate rule hypothesis; the destinations are specifically 90-degree clockwise and 180-degree rotations.

future_check: Keep a focused ordinary-draw regression that requires at least one off-diagonal grid_n/palette_size pair and rejects a one-to-one axis mapping.
rationale: Using draw_int_diff for both axes mapped the same normalized difficulty coordinate into 3..7 and 3..6, producing a one-to-one lock in the ordinary cohort. Palette complexity is semantically separate from panel size and must not be a metadata alias.
summary: Panel size remains difficulty-aware while palette size is sampled independently, so the two observable axes span a real product space.

future_check: Have the independent monitor compare generalized examples against sibling/source-family evidence and reduce their sampling weight if private-distribution evidence favors only dense 3x3 inputs.
rationale: The written/Racket rule generalizes to n-by-n panels, while the four canonical inputs are all dense 3x3 panels. The generalized branch is deliberately bounded to n=3..7, palette size 3..6, at least half occupancy, and strong transform identifiability, but independent intake should still decide the preferred extrapolation weight.
summary: Larger and sparse panels are authority-compatible extrapolations rather than directly demonstrated canonical morphologies.

future_check: After any panel-construction change, require all eight D4 transforms to remain distinct and re-run named competitor checks on canonical and generated examples.
rationale: Every canonical pair disagrees with each named competitor, and every generated source has four distinct rotations and eight distinct D4 transforms. The Racket oracle matches the clockwise-middle and half-turn-right result on 49 audited applications.
summary: Copying, counter-clockwise rotation, swapped destination rotations, and reflection are not adequate rule hypotheses.

future_check: Re-run selected exact sync and execution parity after any canonical, target_code, raw_code, or RULE_HASH change.
rationale: The assignment queue still named rule_source_divergence, but the bundled baseline already carried explicit source roles from a prior candidate. Replacing the archival spelling would erase provenance without changing behavior.
summary: No Racket source patch is proposed: canonical program_solution and selected target_code are byte-exact synchronized; raw_code remains intentionally archival and execution-equivalent.

future_check: After any distribution change, rerun two disjoint 200-draw-per-band censuses and require every draw to retain four distinct rotations, with at least 5% strict canonical-like draws per band.
rationale: The old eight-axis surface included inert or hidden controls and emitted empty, full, monochrome, and rotationally ambiguous panels. The rebuilt surface keeps grid size, exact palette size, and dense/sparse occupancy; all generated sources have four distinct rotations and eight distinct D4 transforms. A 30% canonical anchor preserves demonstrated 3x3/full/three-color morphology in every band.
summary: The repaired distribution exposes only observable task-bearing axes and gives every lesson a spatially discriminative source panel.

future_check: Retain the unknown-key probe as a required fail-closed condition in every task-local override run.
rationale: A typo or renamed axis previously returned a lawful grid and the override checker reported only PASS_WITH_WARNINGS. Silent acceptance makes exact override evidence misleading and hides caller errors.
summary: Unknown override names are rejected before GenCtx construction instead of being silently ignored.
